market_outlook.short_term: Bullish but fragile. Nasdaq record and falling oil support momentum, but 1999-style breadth divergence is a yellow flag. Trump-Xi meeting this week is the binary catalyst—positive outcome extends rally, negative triggers 5-8% correction. Oil likely stays subdued on China import weakness. Crypto momentum continues but CFTC regulatory noise adds volatility. India festive season provides 2-3 week consumer tailwind.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caveats. AI capex supercycle (AMD $1T, Meta Muse, CoreWeave) supports 12-18 month tech leadership but concentration risk demands diversification. Asia inflation into 2027 (ADB) pressures EM. Diesel shortage creates structural energy premium. Private credit stress (Apollo) may spill into broader credit markets. Trump-Xi trade framework, if constructive, opens China tech/AI collaboration (headline 8) benefiting global winners. Social Security 2027 boost and CD rates support consumer financials.
